name: Nadia Bolz-Weber
reason: Too thin on her own site, with a politically framed main offering: nadiabolzweber.com (read 6 Nov 2026) puts her current writing on Substack (off limits), her podcast The Confessional stopped in 2021, her book pages carry only amzn.to links and no ISBNs, there is no YouTube channel, and her one live offering, the Red State Revivals tour, is presented as a response to Christian nationalism (left out under the no-political-content rule). Booking email nadiabookings@gmail.com is published, so the owner could revisit if publisher ISBNs are wanted.
